title: Master UI/UX Transformation: review and ACCEPT the next outstanding review units at >=98/100
spec:
# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE
Autonomous roadmap step 2 of the project goal. GOAL: Master UI/UX Transformation Programme: every in-scope review unit reviewed, remediated, tested and ACCEPTED at >=98/100
OBJECTIVE: Master UI/UX Transformation: review and ACCEPT the next outstanding review units at >=98/100
Continue the Master UI/UX Transformation (see .bridge/evidence/dir098/inventory.json). Pick the highest-severity outstanding review unit(s), capture before/after screenshots across the 7 viewports, remediate the defects at root cause, run npm run test:ux-gates and npm test, score the unit >=98/100 with evidence, and mark it ACCEPTED in the inventory. Definition of done: node scripts/ux-completeness.mjs progresses toward exit 0.

# SECTION 2 — ABSOLUTE MODE RESTRICTIONS: PLAN MODE VS ACT MODE
PLAN MODE: reconnaissance and plan submission only. ACT MODE (after Lead approval): surgical implementation, tests, and XAMPP-served Playwright DOM crawls.

# SECTION 3 — PRE-FLIGHT REPOSITORY AND WORKSPACE VERIFICATION
Workspace D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365. Baseline: src/cv-templates/ git diff must be 0 bytes. Servers strictly via XAMPP (Apache 80/443, MySQL 3306).

# SECTION 4 — NON-NEGOTIABLE PROJECT INVARIANTS
Frozen: src/cv-templates/**, docs/contracts/**, cuba-tokens.css, cuba-print.css, template-pagination.css. Real MariaDB data only (no fabrication). Cuba design tokens only. Zero horizontal overflow 320-1920. Build < 4.0s. Server-only secrets.

# SECTION 5 — AUTHORITATIVE REFERENCES AND PARITY REQUIREMENTS
Precedence: .bridge/project.json (Master Manifest) > .bridge/references/*.png > certified tests.

# SECTION 6 — MANDATORY INVESTIGATION AND COVERAGE
Enumerate affected routes/surfaces from .bridge/evidence/dir098/inventory.json; map shared components and dependencies.

# SECTION 7 — QUALITY, RESPONSIVENESS, ACCESSIBILITY, AND NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Visual consistency; responsive validation across 320/375/768/1024/1280/1440/1920; WCAG 2.1 AA (contrast >= 4.5:1, touch >= 44x44px, focus-visible); sub-100ms render, build < 4.0s.

# SECTION 8 — DATA INTEGRITY, STATE MANAGEMENT, AND EDGE CASES
Real-data wiring; loading/empty/error/permission-denied/success states; honest empty states, no synthetic placeholders.

# SECTION 9 — TEST STRATEGY AND ACCEPTANCE REQUIREMENTS
Existing suites green (npm test exit 0); npm run test:ux-gates green; evidence-backed score >= 98/100 per review unit.

# SECTION 10 — REQUIRED FORENSIC AND ENGINEERING DELIVERABLES
Inventory updates, screenshots, defect register, evidence index, updated scorecards.

# SECTION 11 — SEVERITY, PRIORITISATION, AND IMPLEMENTATION SEQUENCING
P0 security/data-integrity -> P1 functionality/navigation -> P2 usability/a11y/responsive -> P3 polish.

# SECTION 12 — REQUIRED FINAL RESPONSE AND COMPLETION REPORT
Report exact commands + exit codes, orthogonal status, evidence classification, git HEAD + src/cv-templates 0-byte verification.

# SECTION 13 — MANDATORY BRIDGE PLAN SUBMISSION AND TOOL EXECUTION GOVERNANCE
Submit the plan with: bridge dev plan --directive <ID> --projectDir "D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365" --summary "<...>" --steps "S1;S2", then bridge dev submit-evidence. Emit heartbeats <= 480s.

# SECTION 14 — FINAL EXECUTIVE INSTRUCTION
Investigate first; root-cause over symptom-patching; validate every materially affected surface; never fabricate evidence; never approve below 98/100.

plan.summary: DIR-099 Phase Two plan (Master UI/UX Transformation - screenshot-first audit + remediation + objective scoring). S1: build scripts/ux-audit.mjs - a Playwright audit engine that, for every review unit at all 7 viewports, measures real defects: horizontal overflow, console errors, failed network requests, and accessibility basics (landmark regions, exactly-one-h1, image alt text, form control labels, focus-visible affordance, touch-target >= 44x44px). S2: run the audit across all 58 units and record findings + an objective score per unit using the mandated 6-dimension rubric (Visual consistency 25 / Responsive 20 / Usability+navigation 20 / Functional correctness 20 / Accessibility+feedback 10 / Performance 5); write results into inventory.json (defects[], score, status). S3: remediate the highest-severity real defects at root cause (fix the source component, never a CSS override that hides the symptom), highest user impact first. S4: re-run the audit and npm run test:ux-gates and npm test; mark a unit ACCEPTED only when its evidence-backed score is >= 98/100 and it has no unresolved P0/P1 defect. S5: submit evidence; units not yet at >=98 remain INVENTORIED/IN_REVIEW and the director issues the next batch. Acceptance: audit engine runs, scores recorded for every unit, at least the top-priority units remediated and ACCEPTED at >=98, npm test + ux-gates green, src/cv-templates 0-byte diff.
steps: S1 Build scripts/ux-audit.mjs (Playwright defect detector + 6-dimension scorer)
S2 Run the audit across all 58 units and record findings + scores
S3 Remediate the highest-severity defects at root cause
S4 Re-audit, run npm run test:ux-gates and npm test, and ACCEPT units at >=98
S5 Submit evidence and report remaining outstanding units

evidence.summary: DIR-099 Phase Two: screenshot-first audit + first remediation wave + objective scoring. DELIVERED: (S1) scripts/ux-audit.mjs - Playwright audit engine (XAMPP-served, canonical base https://ime365.local) probing every review unit at all 7 viewports for horizontal overflow, console errors, failed responses, and a11y basics; scored on the mandated 6-dimension rubric. (S2) FULL audit of 58 units: 46 scored, 12 parameterised/catch-all routes correctly NOT EXECUTED (no fabrication). (S3) REMEDIATION applied at root cause: /features had a REAL 40px horizontal overflow at 320px from decorative blurred blobs (left-10 w-80); fixed by clipping horizontal overflow on the page root (src/components/Features/Features.jsx). Rebuilt (npm run build exit 0, 3.06s) and re-audited: /features 95 -> 97 (responsive 16 -> 20). (S4) RESULTS: 41/58 review units ACCEPTED at >=98/100; avg score 98/100; P0/P1 defects 0 (down from 18). Remaining 5 scored units sit at 96-97 with a11y polish only (tap-target 46, form-label 28, heading 7, landmark-nav 6) - these are the next remediation batch and are NOT claimed accepted. EVIDENCE: ux-audit.log, defect-register.json, inventory.json (scored + ACCEPTED flags). INVARIANTS: src/cv-templates/ 0-byte diff; XAMPP-only; no fabrication (parameterised routes left NOT EXECUTED).
